title: Priced In or Bet On? Cram-School Lessons, Jeonse Leases, and Expected Appreciation in Seoul
abstract: arXiv:2611.05767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: South Korean families spend heavily on hagwons, private cram schools that prepare students for the university entrance exam. This paper asks what access to them is worth in housing and whether the premium includes expected appreciation. Using 2,197,510 Seoul apartment sales and jeonse (lump-sum deposit lease) contracts from 2015 to 2026, located with a new business-address geocoder, the analysis compares flats within the same middle-school assignment zone and month. Flats near hagwons preparing high-school students for the exam sell and lease for more: moving from the median complex to the 97th percentile of such hagwons within 500 meters is associated with sale prices 11.8% and jeonse deposits 7.3% higher, or 5.6% and 5.9% with complex size held fixed. translated_title: 已计入价格还是押注未来？补习班课程、传贳租约与首尔的预期升值
translated_abstract: 韩国家庭在“学院”上投入巨大，这类私立补习班专门帮助学生备战大学入学考试。本文探讨入学补习的便利在住房市场中价值几何，以及这一溢价中是否包含预期升值的成分。研究利用2015年至2026年间2,197,510笔首尔公寓销售与传贳（一次性押金租赁）合同数据，并借助一套新的营业地址地理编码工具进行定位，在同一初中划片区域和同一月份内对不同公寓进行比较。临近面向高中生备考补习班的公寓售价与押金均更高：在500米范围内，从补习班可达性的中位数小区移动到第97百分位小区，对应售价高出11.8%、传贳押金高出7.3%；若控制小区规模不变，则分别为5.6%和5.9%。在控制上述因素后，面向低龄儿童的补习班不会带来额外的售价溢价。在不同小区之间，押金溢价高于售价溢价，这反映了便利性因素：买方支付低于……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文利用2015–2026年首尔约220万条公寓销售与传贳合同数据发现，临近高中备考补习班的公寓售价溢价约11.8%、传贳押金溢价约7.3%，且押金溢价高于售价溢价，表明补习班的价值更多体现为居住与使用的便利，而非买方将其计入价格并押注未来升值。
en_tdlr: Using 2.2 million Seoul apartment sales and jeonse contracts, this paper shows that flats near exam-prep hagwons command an 11.8% sale-price premium and a 7.3% deposit premium, with the larger premium in deposits than in prices reflecting convenience rather than buyers betting on expected appreciation.
